𝗔𝗹𝗲𝗺 𝗩𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲𝘀 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗶𝗰 𝗕𝗿𝘂𝗻𝗰𝗵 𝘀𝗲𝘁𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗚𝗜𝗧𝗘𝗫 𝗔𝗜 𝗞𝗔𝗭𝗔𝗞𝗛𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗡

H.E. Zhaslan Madiyev, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development of the Republic of Kazakhstan, opened the dialogue on the country’s national AI and digital infrastructure ambitions — reinforcing Kazakhstan’s position as the region’s emerging intelligence economy leader.

Representing GITEX AI KAZAKHSTAN, Yuri took the stage to officially introduce the event to an exclusive room of investors, policymakers, and tech leaders.

On the ground, our team Yuri and Gulnaz — engaged directly with key ecosystem players, including Murat Abdrakhman, Ruslan Ensenbayev, and Bagdat Mussin, strengthening relationships across venture, telecom, and innovation sectors.

From AI infrastructure to venture capital and energy, discussions throughout the brunch reflected one clear direction: Central Asia is accelerating.

Momentum continues building towards GITEX AI KAZAKHSTAN — where these conversations scale into partnerships, investments, and market-defining opportunities.

📍 Pavilion 9-11, Atakent IEC, Almaty
📅 4–5 May 2026

#GITEXAI #GITEXAIKAZAKHSTAN #AlemVentures #CentralAsiaTech #AI VentureCapital DigitalKazakhstan
